source_text: For instance, in Indonesia, national data indicate that approximately 49% of girls aged 0-14 have undergone FGC, yet ethnographic studies describe most as symbolic rituals involving a drop of blood via pricking, leading critics to argue that such inclusions inflate global estimates without reflecting equivalent harm levels found in African excisional practices.
